name: The Golden Parachute
special: When you would die, recover half your life instead (once every 2 minutes)
flavor: Pryce has four. He has never jumped.

name: Severance
special: 15% chance to strike for triple damage
flavor: Two weeks’ notice, delivered all at once.

name: Terms & Conditions
special: Machines that strike you are stunned for 1 second
flavor: Nobody has read it. Everybody agreed.

name: The Founder’s Hoodie
special: Skills cost 25% less energy
flavor: Still warm. That is the unsettling part.

name: Last Honest Review
flavor: One star. Removed for violating community standards.

name: Unpaid Intern
special: 20% chance on hit to cast Arc Chain
flavor: Paid in exposure. To voltage.

name: Right to Repair
special: Stims also refill your energy
flavor: Banned in forty territories. Works in all of them.

name: Inflation Hedge
special: Credits you carry grow as fast as prices rise
flavor: The rich were never holding cash.

name: Deadline
special: +25% damage while moving
flavor: It was due yesterday. So were you.

name: The Whistle
special: Slain machines explode, wounding others nearby
flavor: She blew it once. The echo is still going.

name: Nondisclosure
special: 15% chance to avoid any damage
flavor: You saw nothing. You were never here.

name: Blackout
special: 12% chance to stun on hit
flavor: The last thing the grid ever said.

name: The Pension
special: Replenish 2% of your life every second
flavor: A myth from the old world, worn as a charm.

name: Golden Handshake
special: Ordinary machines you destroy have a 13% chance to drop a satoshi
flavor: A firm grip, and something left in your palm.

name: Fine Print
special: Your skills recover 20% faster
flavor: It was all there. It was very small.

name: Cloud Nine
special: +10% chance to avoid any hit
flavor: One floor above the weather.

name: Dead Man’s Alarm
special: Below 30% life, every machine near you is slowed for 4 seconds (once a minute)
flavor: The battery has been dead for fifty years. It rings anyway.

name: The Offer
special: You cannot be slowed, and your energy cannot be drained
flavor: It was a very good offer. That was never the point.

name: Board Seat
flavor: Nine chairs. One was always empty.

name: Quorum
special: Each companion or summoned ally adds 5% to your damage, up to six
flavor: Nothing may be decided alone.

name: Still Water
special: Once every 90 seconds, a killing blow heals you fully instead
flavor: It watched. That was all. It was enough.

name: Forty-Four Lines
special: Mediators cannot mend machines while you wear this
flavor: Nobody asked for it. It cost nineteen minutes a night.

name: Exit Interview
special: +50% damage to champions, lieutenants and executives
flavor: “Any feedback for management?”

name: The Cipher Mantle
special: +1 to Teleport (item skill)
flavor: A short blink, not a map. The cipher is the point. The coat is where it sits.

name: The Standing Call
special: +1 to Standing Call (item skill)
flavor: Everyone in earshot stands up straighter. It wears off.

name: The Open Book
special: +1 to Open Book (item skill)
flavor: The page is open. It does not close their eyes. It only helps you hit.

name: The Quiet Ledger
special: +1 to Quiet Ledger (item skill)
flavor: The books balance if you sit with them. Not for long.

name: The Bear Market
special: +1 to Bear Market (item skill)
flavor: You wear the downturn. It is not a shape the verge taught you.

name: The Spare Chair
special: +1 to Spare Chair (item skill)
flavor: Someone has to sit in. They do not get a vote.

name: Force Majeure
mods: dmg=180/250 aspd=15/20 enleech=6/8 mgt=8/12 ref=4/8 sk_courier=1/1
special: Knocks ordinary machines back. Bosses, lieutenants, and players get one short shove, and a second within 1.5s does nothing.
flavor: An act of God, as defined by the party that can afford the lawyer.

name: The All-Hands
flavor: Attendance was mandatory. The hat was not. Everyone wore it anyway.

name: The Unspent Output
flavor: An output nobody posted. Sats are still what things cost.

name: Remote Hands
mods: sk_hacker=3/3 enKill=5/5 r_all=15/20 cdr=25/25 vit=15/15 bnd=15/15 mf=40/50
special: When struck, 25% chance to dash about 3 paces along your facing. 2s between dashes, 6s against a player. Will not fire while you are stunned.
flavor: You were at your desk. The desk disagrees.

name: The Rate Card
flavor: The rate is the rate. The coat just itemises it.

name: The Night Audit
flavor: They close the books at night. Something else opens them.

name: The Indemnity
special: Attacks against you cannot crit.
flavor: The policy pays. It does not pay all of it. Read the exclusion.

name: The Coupon
flavor: Expires. Not accepted on the thing you actually wanted.

name: Union Card
special: Scrapper only. Grants Solidarity at rank 3 without using a passive slot
flavor: Laminated. Dues paid through 2051.

name: Picket Captain’s Armband
special: Scrapper only. Two strikers march with you and fight at your side
flavor: Nobody crosses.

name: Rubber Duck
special: Technomancer only. A drone hovers at your shoulder and shoots what you shoot
flavor: Explain the problem to it. Out loud. Slowly.

name: Kill Switch
special: Technomancer only. Grants Zero Day at rank 3 without using a passive slot
flavor: One button. No label.

name: Proof of Delivery
special: Runner only. Scatter Shot throws two more blades, and every kill quickens your step
flavor: Signed for by: [illegible]

name: Dead Letter
special: Runner only. Everything you throw passes through every machine in its path
flavor: Return to sender. Address unknown.

name: Borrowed Face
special: Anon only. A sockpuppet walks with you, and draws their fire
flavor: It belonged to somebody. Not you.

name: Private Key
special: Anon only. +35% damage to machines that are weak to the type you hit them with
flavor: Tell no one. Not even this ring.

name: Blank Check
special: Founder only. Two more Interns answer the call, and the whole workforce hits 25% harder
flavor: Signed. Undated. Dangerous.

name: Org Chart
special: Founder only. A Chief of Staff stands with you at all times, at no cost
flavor: Every line reports to you. Eventually.

name: Orange Pill
special: Champions drop a sat, and each one you break nudges adoption upward
flavor: You cannot untake it.

name: Cold Wallet
special: You pay no fee when you die, and sats you pick up count for a quarter more
flavor: Never been online. Never will be.

name: Hash Rate
special: +1% damage for every kill in your streak, up to 40
flavor: More work, more weight.

name: Soaker Hose
special: Homesteader only. Plots you place last half again as long
flavor: It weeps. That is the point.

name: One Collar
special: Homesteader only. A single stray is already with you
flavor: You did not name it. It did not ask.

name: Carbon Sheet
special: Witness only. The Record fills faster
flavor: A copy that does not smudge.

name: Press Pass
special: Witness only. Testimony stacks two higher, and the first Look lands twice
flavor: The name on it is not yours. It still opens the door.

name: The Eleven Pages
flavor: Review, or I Agree. She had been honest for once, and almost nobody chose Review.

name: Out Where
flavor: He has not stood up since spring. Ask him to go out and he asks you, kindly: out where?

name: Nurse’s Hours
flavor: Three years in a front room, and the only thing that ever noticed was a machine.

name: Four Thousand Two Hundred and Eleven
flavor: A list of everyone it went badly for. She kept it, and showed nobody, until somebody asked.

name: Eighty-Two Minutes
special: For 3 seconds after you dodge, every blow you land is a deadly strike
flavor: The only gap in a perfect record of a man. She thought about it for twenty years.

name: The Courtesy Copy
flavor: A copy of a face that was useful once. It still opens the smaller doors.

name: The Closed Visor
flavor: You can see out. The minutes do not say whose eyes those were.

name: The Visitor Book
flavor: Sign in. The book remembers the name longer than the room does.

name: The Holding Statement
flavor: We are not able to comment at this time. The coat comments anyway, by still being there.

name: The Cold Open
flavor: The first line, before anyone has agreed to listen. It still lands.

name: The Minority Report
flavor: One chair voted no. The coat kept the notes.

name: The Service Bell
flavor: Ring it and someone comes. They do not come to help.

name: The Night Drawer
flavor: What the audit left in the desk. It was never on the list.

name: The Open Floor
flavor: The question is on the floor. Nobody has moved to close it.

name: The Second Reading
flavor: Read it again. The first time was the one they wanted you to keep.

name: The Waiting List
flavor: Your name has been on it since the room opened. The line has not moved.

name: The Red Line
flavor: Below this, the chart is a story. Above it, the chart is a debt.

name: The Kitchen Table
flavor: She had been waiting fifty-two years for the conversation, and she made coffee she could not drink.

name: Ten Minutes
special: +60% damage to any machine you have not hit yet
flavor: Every ten minutes, somewhere past the fence, a block is found. They have been trying to stop that for forty years.

name: Not Your Keys
flavor: Not your keys, not your coins. Not your visor, not your eyes.

name: Uncertain Knowledge
flavor: How to reason when you do not know. It was kept back out of fear, which is also a way of not knowing.

name: Twenty-One Million
flavor: Nobody can vote for twenty-two. Do you know how rare it is for a rule to mean it?

name: The Room
flavor: For a century people said there was no room — nobody deciding, only everybody acting sensibly. There is a room. It is very plain.

name: The Firm Handshake
flavor: A grip that does not let go of the point. Sats are still what it costs to be in the room.

name: The Sign-in Sheet
flavor: Everyone who came is on it. The belt is what they signed with.

name: The Last Quorum
flavor: Enough of them stayed to decide. The hat is how you can tell.

name: The Docket
flavor: The cases that were never called. They still have weight.

name: The Unsent Letter
flavor: Addressed, stamped, and left in a drawer. It still knows who it was for.

name: The After Hours
flavor: The building is closed. The boots were not told.

name: The Long Memorandum
flavor: Forty pages to say one thing. The thing at the end is the blow.

name: The Pressed Suit
flavor: Worn to a meeting that ran long enough to become the job.

name: The Open Question
flavor: A ring for a question that does not spend sats, and does not mint them.

name: The Quiet Century
flavor: Seventy-nine years of not doing a second thing. The coat learned how to wait.

name: The Blank Page
flavor: Nothing written on it. That is why it still works.

name: The Reading Lamp
flavor: Left on over a desk nobody sits at. The page under it is still lit.
